methods.notes: SoundTouch units advertise _soundtouch._tcp (and _raop._tcp on AirPlay-capable models). Confirm a hit by fetching GET /info on port 8090 and reading the device id and MAC. SSDP (MediaRenderer) is a fallback.

device.name: Bose SoundTouch Speakers
device.notes:
SoundTouch is Bose's discontinued multi-room speaker line — SoundTouch 10/20/30, Portable, Wave SoundTouch, the SA-4/SA-5 amplifiers and the Lifestyle/CineMate/VideoWave systems. Bose shut the SoundTouch cloud on 2026-05-06, ending presets, in-app streaming and firmware updates, but patched the app for local-only control and PUBLISHED the local API at end-of-life. Local control therefore survives the cloud: every speaker serves an unauthenticated HTTP/XML API on port 8090 with a WebSocket push channel on port 8080, and AirPlay / Spotify Connect / Bluetooth / AUX keep working. This is a rescue where the vendor itself left the door open.
NOTE: the newer Bose "Home Speaker" 300/500/700 and Portable Home Speaker do NOT use this API — they are a different product family. This spec covers only the SoundTouch line.
CONTROL SURFACE (HTTP on port 8090; get* = GET, set* = POST with an XML body; no authentication):
  POST /key         — press/release a control key (see the key enum)
  GET  /now_playing — current track/source/art/playStatus
  GET/POST /volume  — 0-100, plus a muteenabled flag
  POST /select      — choose an input by ContentItem (AUX/BLUETOOTH/PRODUCT)
  GET  /sources     — the available inputs and their READY/UNAVAILABLE state
  GET  /presets     — the six physical presets (ids 1-6)
  GET  /info        — device id/type, components (firmware/serial), MAC/IP
  GET/POST /bass, GET /bassCapabilities — bass level and its range
  GET /getZone, POST /setZone, /addZoneSlave, /removeZoneSlave — multi-room
Default success response is <status>VALUE</status>; errors are an <errors> element carrying <error value= name= severity=/>.
PUSH: connect a WebSocket to ws://<ip>:8080 with subprotocol "gabbo". The speaker pushes <updates deviceID=...> wrappers on change: nowPlayingUpdated, volumeUpdated, presetsUpdated, zoneUpdated, sourcesUpdated, bassUpdated, connectionStateUpdated, infoUpdated and more.

openness.notes: Bose released the "SoundTouch Web API" specification at end-of-life under a royalty-free but revocable licence. Because the licence is revocable and forbids redistributing the document, this spec paraphrases the protocol as independent derived facts and does not reproduce the vendor text. The community libsoundtouch/bosesoundtouchapi clients predate the public docs and agree with them.

credentials.notes: The control API (port 8090) is unauthenticated on the LAN: anything on the network can drive the speaker. The Wi-Fi passphrase is handled by the app's setup flow, not the control API documented here.

factory_reset.effect: A factory reset clears Wi-Fi credentials and returns the speaker to setup mode. Per-model button/power-cycle procedures exist (documented in Bose's own support material); the exact key sequence is model-specific and not transcribed here.

procedures.basis: Bose support documents a per-model reset (typically hold a button while powering on, or a 10-button-hold on units with a keypad). Not replayed by this project.
procedures.name: Power-cycle factory reset (model-specific)

steps.action: Follow the model's Bose-documented reset (button hold during power-on).
steps.expect: The speaker returns to Wi-Fi setup mode.

methods.description: Use the (now local-only) SoundTouch app or the speaker's wired setup to join the home Wi-Fi. Once on the LAN the port-8090 API answers with no further onboarding.

steps.action: Run the SoundTouch app's setup (or wired setup) and give the speaker the home Wi-Fi credentials.
steps.expect: The speaker joins the LAN and answers GET /info on port 8090.

setup.notes: Out-of-box, a SoundTouch speaker is joined to Wi-Fi via the SoundTouch app over a wired setup or a temporary setup network. Since 2026-05-06 the patched app performs setup, configuration and grouping fully locally (no account). The provisioning wire steps are not documented here — low.

rejoin.notes: Wi-Fi can be re-run from the app while the speaker is reachable; a physical reset is only needed if the old network is already gone.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. Facts are paraphrased from Bose's own SoundTouch Web API document (published at end-of-life) and cross-checked against the libsoundtouch / bosesoundtouchapi community clients.

http_endpoints.description: Device id/type, component list (each with softwareVersion and serialNumber), and networkInfo (MAC/IP). The endpoint that confirms a device is SoundTouch and yields the stable deviceID.
http_endpoints.name: Device information

fields.description: Stable device identity (attribute on the <info> element).
fields.name: deviceID

http_endpoints.description: Current source, ContentItem, track/artist/album/stationName, art URL and playStatus.
http_endpoints.name: Now playing

http_endpoints.description: <volume> with target/actual volume 0-100 and a <muteenabled> flag.
http_endpoints.name: Read volume

http_endpoints.description: Body <key state="press|release" sender="Gabbo">KEY</key>. Send a press then a release. KEY includes PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, PREV_TRACK, NEXT_TRACK, POWER, MUTE, VOLUME_UP, VOLUME_DOWN, PRESET_1..PRESET_6, AUX_INPUT, SHUFFLE_ON/OFF, REPEAT_ONE/ALL, THUMBS_UP/DOWN.
http_endpoints.name: Press a control key

http_endpoints.description: The six physical presets (ids 1-6), each a ContentItem.
http_endpoints.name: List presets

http_endpoints.description: Body <zone master="MASTER_MAC" senderIPAddress=...><member ipaddress=...> MEMBER_MAC</member></zone> to play the master's audio on the members.
http_endpoints.name: Create a multi-room zone

websocket.description: Push channel. Connect ws://<ip>:8080 with subprotocol "gabbo"; the speaker emits <updates deviceID=...> wrappers on change (nowPlayingUpdated, volumeUpdated, presetsUpdated, zoneUpdated, sourcesUpdated, bassUpdated, connectionStateUpdated, infoUpdated).
